STEP 1 - Scene: A breakfast tray with a fried-egg and toast plate, a small muffin plate, a mug of drink, and a butter portion. Photographed from the front at a slightly elevated angle, with a colour calibration card in front.

STEP 2 - Ruler: The main plate (left) is a disposable white plate, about 23 cm in diameter, so area ≈ 3.14 × (11.5)² ≈ 415 cm². The muffin plate is smaller, about 18 cm (area ≈ 254 cm²), and it is a separate plate, so it is counted as its own item.

STEP 3 - Items (main plate): two fried eggs, one slice of bread (white/wholemeal, toasted). Other items: one butter portion, one muffin (on its own plate), one mug of hot drink (milk-based, likely coffee or tea with milk). The mug is not weighed here as a plate item but is listed.

STEP 4 - Area (main plate, 415 cm²):
- Fried eggs: ~30% (125 cm²)
- Bread slice: ~20% (83 cm²)
- Remaining plate is bare.

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Fried eggs: 125 cm² × 1.0 cm ≈ 125 ml
- Bread slice: ~83 cm² × 1.5 cm (thick slice, ~1.5 cm high) ≈ 125 ml... the slice itself is roughly 12 cm × 10 cm × 1.5 cm ≈ 180 ml by its visible dimensions, so use 180 ml.
- Muffin: about 7 cm diameter × 5 cm high, roughly 150 ml (cupcake-shaped).

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Eggs: 125 ml × 0.95 ≈ 120 g
- Bread slice: 180 ml × 0.3 ≈ 55 g (bread loaf density applied, since it is a light sandwich-style slice)
- Muffin: 150 ml × 0.5 ≈ 75 g
- Butter portion: ~7 g
- Milk drink in mug: ~150 g (about 150 ml in the mug, roughly 1.0 g/ml)

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Fried egg (cooked): 120 g × 196 kcal/100 g ≈ 235 kcal
- Bread (white toast): 55 g × 265 kcal/100 g ≈ 146 kcal
- Muffin (savoury, egg/cheese style): 75 g × 300 kcal/100 g ≈ 225 kcal
- Butter: 7 g × 717 kcal/100 g ≈ 50 kcal
- Milk-based drink: 150 g × 50 kcal/100 g ≈ 75 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total about 330 g of food plus drink, about 730 kcal. This is plausible for a full cooked breakfast with a muffin and a milky drink.
